test_description: heuristic file path metadata extraction should create track and album entities from file path structure
commit_message:
Implement heuristic file path metadata extraction with Room entity integration

- Add HeuristicFilePathMetadataExtractor class for PLY-122
- Extract artist/album/title from file path structure 
- Create EnhancedTrackEntity, EnhancedAlbumEntity, AlbumTrackEntity
- Implement confidence scoring system (0.0-1.0 range)
- Support various path structures gracefully
- Pass comprehensive test coverage for path parsing
